title: Brush and broom clearing on a Sooke acreage

seo.title: Sample project: Sooke brush and broom clearing | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: Scotch broom, blackberry and brush cleared on a Sooke acreage, keeping native trees, with invasive material disposed of properly. Free quote.

summary: Scotch broom and blackberry cleared from a rural lot while keeping native trees.
story: Broom and blackberry had closed in the driveway and a field.
We cut and pulled broom before it set seed, cleared blackberry, kept the young firs and arbutus and disposed of the invasive material following CRD guidance.
Read more about [tree and vegetation work](/services/tree-vegetation/), see our work in [Sooke](/areas/sooke/), or [get a free quote](/quote/).
result: An open driveway and field, with native trees kept.
